rule.primary_region: completed_unobserved = GT occupied (labelled) & frozen predicted occupied & no direct causal evidence
rule.statistic: per seed: mIoU of the confusion pooled over all 590 anchors of 0006; decisions use the mean over seeds 0/1/2

P2_overall_ssc_gain.metric: SSC mIoU(B1) - SSC mIoU(B0) on ssc_full under frozen predicted occupancy

rule.P4_occupancy_unchanged: per seed, occupancy TP/FP/FN over the 590 anchors (Gate 12 regions 'full') equal the frozen baseline's source_eval counts exactly; geometry state digests unchanged by training
decision_order: D if the teacher readout of the evidence on oracle_observed has overall accuracy < 0.40 or mIoU < 0.15
A if P1, P2, P3 and P4 all pass
C if P1 fails and the collapse clause of P3 fails (dominant fraction above its limit or < 5 classes with >= 1 % of predictions)
rule.B0: nearest evidence voxel label (3D Euclidean, no radius); evaluation/baseline_nearest.py
rule.checkpoint_rule: final step 6000 of each head seed, no selection
rule.disclosure: The Decision-D thresholds were written after a 10-anchor smoke test of the evaluator with an untrained (20-step) head, which showed a teacher readout of ~0.23 mIoU / 0.64 accuracy on observed voxels; the thresholds were the ones considered before that run and are not tuned to it. No trained-head result existed when this rule was frozen.
